Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment
Markets.summary: US stocks rose on Wednesday, with the Nasdaq leading the market higher due to positive sentiment around artificial intelligence stocks like SpaceX and Super Micro Computer. Losses in communication shares like Netflix and AT&T limited further gains as investors awaited upcoming tech earnings.

Markets.title: Meta raises AI spending forecast to $145 billion, plans new share issue; Q3 revenue beats estimates
Markets.summary: Meta increased its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion to accelerate artificial intelligence expansion and announced plans for a new share issue. Meanwhile, the company reported third-quarter revenue that beat estimates despite facing mounting legal challenges and intensifying competition.

Markets.title: BlackRock expands AI push with new robotics ETF as investor enthusiasm cools
Markets.summary: BlackRock launched a new robotics-focused exchange-traded fund to target companies using intelligent machines in industries like manufacturing and transportation. The fund expands BlackRock's artificial intelligence offerings as investor enthusiasm for the technology becomes more selective.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields slip as AI concerns boost safe haven demand ahead of 20 year auction
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields declined as investor concerns over the impact of borrowing costs on AI stocks increased safe-haven demand. This market movement occurred ahead of a $13 billion 20-year Treasury auction and expectations of a muted Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
Markets.summary: Persistent Systems has launched a qualified institutional placement to raise up to $450 million, or approximately Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company set the floor price for the offering at Rs 5,550 per share with a potential discount of up to 5%.

Markets.title: Stocks, gold or crypto? The last 3 years’ returns have a surprising answer
Markets.summary: Over a three-year period, Bitcoin outperformed gold, silver, and equities with nearly 234% returns. However, precious metals performed better over the last year as cryptocurrency values declined.

Geo-Political.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
Geo-Political.summary: Russia stated it is prepared to resume peace talks with Ukraine and the United States to end the war. This announcement followed a meeting in St. Petersburg between Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
Geo-Political.summary: US diplomatic efforts are unlikely to bring an end to the war in Ukraine soon. Russian President Vladimir Putin currently feels no pressure to stop the conflict.

Geo-Political.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron accused foreign leaders of exploiting recent riots in France for their own political gain. This remark was apparently aimed at U.S. President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, both of whom face upcoming elections.

Geo-Political.title: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
Geo-Political.summary: Test results confirmed the Pope was diagnosed with localized lung adenocarcinoma. He does not require further treatment following his lung cancer surgery.

Geo-Political.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
Geo-Political.summary: A much-loved Australian Member of Parliament survived a targeted attack that required the amputation of both legs. Local residents are heartbroken, describing the MP as a genuinely kind person and a dedicated community advocate.

Geo-Political.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
Geo-Political.summary: The Irish state has apologized to the family of Brian Stack, a prison officer who was shot by the IRA in Dublin in 1983. Stack died from his injuries 18 months after the attack.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These tools aim to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and boost overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create engaging and relevant content efficiently.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative options for users.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee members opposed shifting the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. Despite this disagreement, all six members unanimously supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement output. Meanwhile, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew 7.9% year-on-year in September, surpassing the 3.1% growth recorded in the same month last year. This expansion was driven largely by increased production in the coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore sectors.

Data & Insights.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF recommends allowing currencies to adjust naturally to global shocks because foreign-exchange interventions offer limited long-term benefits. This advice comes as the Reserve Bank of India increases efforts to defend the rupee against pressures from oil prices and foreign outflows.

Data & Insights.title: Govt to overhaul tax refund schemes for exporters, sets up two panels
Data & Insights.summary: The government is overhauling tax refund schemes for exporters following a late-last-month recommendation by the expenditure finance committee. Two panels have been established to ensure better targeting and optimal use of funds.

India.title: Protest Photos By Priyanka Gandhi's Son Taken Down At Delhi's Bikaner House. Officials Flagged 'Timing', He Tells NDTV
India.summary: Officials at Delhi's Bikaner House removed an art exhibition of youth protest photographs by Raihan Vadra, Priyanka Gandhi's son. Vadra stated that officials flagged the timing and content of the display as objectionable.

India.title: Child Assault Convict, Nepali Citizen Escape From Chennai's Central Prison
India.summary: Sudeep Bogati, a 21-year-old Nepali citizen and child assault convict, escaped from Chennai's Central Prison. He had been held in the foreign nationals' block following an August 16 arrest for a theft case.

India.title: 'No More Jantar Mantar Protest Calls': Vow By CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka In Court
India.summary: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were released from judicial custody after vowing in court not to issue any more protest calls at Jantar Mantar. The two had been detained since October 14 for scaling the locked gates of Jantar Mantar and waving the national flag to protest its removal as a designated protest site.

India.title: Air Quality Commission Meets Delhi Government Agencies Over Dust Pollution
India.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management met with Delhi government agencies to address dust pollution. The Commission emphasized that all agencies must strictly comply with and implement its statutory directions.

India.title: Nestle, Zydus Wellness Get Notices Over Claims About Infant Nutrition Products, Complan
India.summary: India's food safety authority issued notices to Nestle and Zydus Wellness regarding marketing claims made on infant nutrition products and Complan. Specifically, the regulator demanded scientific evidence to support Complan's claim of promoting "2 times faster growth."

India.title: No Money, No Problem? Robbers Make Man Take Loan To Loot Him In Chennai
India.summary: Robbers in Chennai forced a victim to take an app-based loan after finding he had no cash. They then withdrew 9,500 rupees from an ATM using the newly sanctioned funds.

General.title: Burnham defends Jackdaw decision as Badenoch urges PM to overturn ban on new oil and gas licences
General.summary: Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham defended the upcoming start of gas production at the Jackdaw field by the end of this month, despite opposition from environmental campaigners. Meanwhile, Conservative leadership contender Kemi Badenoch urged Prime Minister Keir Starmer to overturn the ban on new oil and gas licences.

General.title: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
General.summary: Critical cyber-security vulnerabilities have been discovered in PHP, a widely used programming language. These flaws are considered the most significant ever found by artificial intelligence and have caused worldwide website outages.

General.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
General.summary: Russia announced it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and the U.S. to end the war. This followed a meeting in St. Petersburg between Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff.

General.title: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
General.summary: US diplomatic efforts to end the war in Ukraine currently offer little hope for an imminent peace. President Vladimir Putin does not feel pressured by these efforts to stop the fighting.

General.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
General.summary: A much-loved Australian MP suffered the amputation of both legs in a targeted attack. The local community is heartbroken over the incident, remembering the politician as a kind person who fought for them.

General.title: Google staff resign in backlash over its AI contracts with military
General.summary: Several current and former Google DeepMind employees have resigned in protest over the company's artificial intelligence contracts with the military. These workers raised serious ethical concerns regarding the use of AI technology in battlefield operations.
